statement: There are n people at a party, numbered 0 to n − 1. You are given the n × n matrix matrix, where matrix[i][j] is 1 if person i knows person j and 0 otherwise. matrix[i][i] is 0.
A celebrity is someone who is known by everyone else but knows no one. There is at most one celebrity.
Return the number of the celebrity, or −1 if there is none.

examples.explanation: Persons 0 and 2 both know person 1, and person 1 knows nobody.
Persons 0 and 1 know each other, so neither can be the celebrity, and nobody knows person 2.
Everyone else knows person 1 and person 1's row is all 0s. Many other people know each other, but that does not matter.
